Sum of the angles is (n-2)·180 = 1070 + x, with 0 < x < 180.

So 1070 < (n-2)·180 < 1250. Dividing by 180 gives 5.94 < n-2 < 6.94, so n-2 = 6 and n = 8. Then the total is 1080 and x = 10°, which is valid.

The answer is 8.

Solution 1 gets 8. Its reasoning only used the upper bound, but the result is right.

Solution 2 says n=6 gives x=70°, but (6-2)·180 = 720, so x would be negative. It is wrong.

Solution 3 is wrong. It also contradicts itself, since it computes 1080 − 1070 = 10 for n=8 and then picks 9.
